why: Chat chrome is not shipped; a compiled recipe on ui/* is its only legal source, so two AI apps share one thread look. The P12 spike decides the scroller.
what: The chat-thread recipe region in the playground, its prose page, a thread fixture for one-look, and the Chrome layout test. No ./ai export. Paths are under packages/basalt-ui/ unless they start with apps/.
must_not_touch: package.json and bun.lock (v3-deps-w2 / v3-deps-ai added your pins)
contract: docs/v3/concepts/ai-mdx.md decision 9, rows 1 and 13, P12; docs/v3/spikes/scroller.md names the winner (use-stick-to-bottom or message-scroller); the loser stays out of every lockfile. Recipe law (skills-agent-layer 3.16): `// #region recipe:chat-thread` of a compiled playground file plus at most 15 lines prose, at most 60 lines. Imports basalt-ui/* and ui/* only. Needs ui/{textarea,button,scroll-area,virtual-list} (v3-prim-p3a-inputs, p5a, p5b) and the rule from v3-ai-i5-lint; all ancestors.
exemplar: v3-ai-i3's partView and the first landed recipe in apps/playground/src/recipes/.
change: Component-owned `useState(() => new Chat({transport}))`, `useChat({chat, experimental_throttle: 100})`; message without a bubble rendering partView; composer per A13 (Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, IME respected, optimistic restore); one polite live region announcing on settle; `data-state` streaming|settled and aria-busy on the streaming block; the P12 winner as scroller; ui/virtual-list only if the fixture needs it. The file also exports the thread fixture used by one-look and the layout test. Consumers copy it to src/components/chat (no eject). Rule: `bun run lint` at the app preset (v3-gr-4-preset) passes over the recipe, including the useChat sub-check of v3-ai-i5-lint (no useChat() without chat); a raw-scroll waiver on the scroller needs a reason. Skill snippet: the recipe region.
commits: Two commits in one PR: packages/basalt-ui/** apart from everything else (isolated-basalt-ui hook); `make sync-self` output its own non-package commit; conventional, empty scope, no feat! or BREAKING CHANGE, no attribution; rebase-merge.
proof: `make layout` chat-thread: 90 s mock stream sticks to bottom, a user scroll-up is not yanked back, image reflow and a 390 px keyboard resize keep the last line visible; axe; shots at both viewports, dark and light.
acceptance: `bun run --cwd apps/playground typecheck` compiles `// #region recipe:chat-thread` and `bun packages/basalt-ui/scripts/gen-recipes.ts --check` exits 0
chat-thread.layout.test.ts: after a streamed reflow the last line is within 1 px of the viewport bottom; after a user scroll-up nothing auto-scrolls until the user returns to bottom
axe on the thread fixture reports 0 serious or critical violations and exactly one polite live region exists
`rg -c 'use-stick-to-bottom|message-scroller' bun.lock` shows only the spike's winner
recipe prose plus region is at most 60 lines (`wc -l`)
`rg -n chat-thread packages/basalt-ui/agent/skills/basalt-app/references/recipes.md` matches and `bun test tests/agent/sk-8` passes
out_of_scope: Exported Message or Composer, thread list, mentions, branches, reasoning and approval recipes, a runtime.
